keywords: Newton's Laws 2.Work 3.Mechanical Energy 4.Rotational Motion 5.Motion of Rigid Body
educationalGoal: In this course, students learn the basics of physics, such as description of motion, equations of motion for mass points and rigid bodies, work and energy, using vectors, differentiation and integral. In addition, the goal is to develop the ability to gain insight into the physics behind natural phenomena by applying the knowledge they have learned and through logical thinking and data analysis.
advice: Logical thinking and data analysis are conducted based on actual measurement data, and the ability to gain insight into the physics behind natural phenomena is nurtured. The course outline is as follows: 1. exercise description: Units of physical quantities, position and displacement, velocity, acceleration 2. Newton's laws of motion and equations of motion: Newton's first law of motion (law of inertia), Newton's second law of motion (equation of motion), Newton's third law of motion (law of action and reaction), impulse and momentum 3. work and energy: Work and energy, conservative and non-conservative forces, kinetic energy of translational motion, potential energy, conservation of mechanical energy, collision and coefficient of restitution of objects 4. Rotational motion of mass point and mass system: The rotational motion, angular velocity and angular acceleration of the mass point. moment of inertia, moment of force (torque), equation of motion of rotation, angular momentum, center of mass, motion of mass system 5. rigid body motion: Equilibrium of rigid body, moment of inertia of rigid body, angular acceleration, equation of motion of rigid body, kinetic energy of rotational motion, conservation of mechanical energy in motion of rigid body
books: Textbooks: Not specified Reference books: Serway Principles of Physics (mechanics) [Tokyo Kagaku Dougin] Reserved books: Basics of Physics 5th Edition [Gakujutsu Tosho Shuppan-sha Co., Ltd.]
requiredKnowledge: Background knowledge: Basic knowledge of elementary mathematics such as trigonometric ratios, vectors, differentiation, integration, etc. Skills: Trigonometric ratios, vectors, differentiation, integration, etc., elementary mathematics calculation skills

activityGoals.body: Ability to express the motion of an object using position/displacement, velocity, and acceleration.
Ability to express the motion of an object in terms of motion equations and obtain acceleration and velocity.
Ability to understand work and energy and explain the conservation of mechanical energy.
Ability to represent rotational motion with equations of motion and obtain acceleration and velocity.
Ability to understand basic physics vocabulary and phrases.
Ability to understand the content of the lesson by completing the homework and paticipating in group activities.
